description: Use this when a visitor asks whether a park has reservations or blockout dates for a ticket or pass type on given dates at a supported resort. Returns availability by segment (ticket or pass type) for up to 31 days. Ask for the fewest days you need; long ranges are large.

date.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD, from today through 399 days ahead. Defaults to today.

days.description: Number of consecutive days, 1 to 31. Defaults to 7.

resort.description: Resort key (walt-disney-world, disneyland-resort, universal-orlando, universal-studios-hollywood), canonical ID, name, or shorthand (wdw, dlr, uor, ush).

name: parky_get_park_availability
title: Get park reservation availability
